title: Enthrone
summary: ENTHRO'NE, verb transitive [from throne.] To place on a throne; to exalt to the seat of royalty. Beneath a sculptured arch he sits enthroned. 1. To exalt to an elevated place or seat. 2. To invest wit

inlines.v: ENTHRO'NE, verb transitive [from throne.] To place on a throne; to exalt to the seat of royalty. Beneath a sculptured arch he sits enthroned. 1. To exalt to an elevated place or seat. 2. To invest with sovereign authority.
